answer: Deposits are visible in vault, and grove reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 39% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 45 aliases, and each one needs its own funded mesa account. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 5 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
